page.notes: The two lines after "Deum deprecantur:" are in an Oriental script (probably Syriac or Arabic letters), not Greek or Hebrew. I could not read them letter by letter, so they are marked illegible. The Latin prayer below them is italic. The first word of the page is a fragment from the previous page and is kept as such. The hyphens in "fa-tear", "impossibi-litate" and the final "fi-" are printed line-end hyphens.
